protocol.I/O_caveat: No page-cache flushing; lazy vertex timer covers file open/mmap creation. Page faults/materialization can be charged to conversion. Normal read timer combines ZIP reading/decompression.
protocol.resident: sampled raw float64 normal matrices and vertices in RAM; identical public float32 conversion/collation/loss
protocol.scope: Data assembly plus public LAVA forward and prediction-gradient backward only; excludes model forward/backward, optimizer, evaluation, diagnostics, persistence and one-time shared geometry construction.
